tests.title: Editor cannot see another user's contacts or report
tests.goal: Contacts and reports of a template are visible only to its owner.
preconditions: Admin account (TWW_QA_ADMIN_* in .env)
The admin creates a QA editor (and, for viewer cases, a QA viewer) in 用戶管理 > 添加用户 and deletes them afterwards

steps.text: As admin create a draft template qa_owner_<unique> (Meta unticked) and upload the contacts file to it
Log out and log in as the QA editor
On 消息模版 click 從 Twilio 同步
Click the qa_owner_<unique> card
In the address bar add /contacts to the template URL and open it
In the address bar open the report link: replace /templates/ with /api/templates/ and add /export to the template URL
Log back in as admin and delete qa_owner_<unique> (cleanup)

expected.text: After sync the editor's list does not show qa_owner_<unique>
The template page says 模板不存在
The contacts page shows no contacts (or a no-permission message), not QA Tester's name and phone
The report link does not download a file

notes: Editor (other user) gets 404 on contacts, export, responses, stats of the QA admin template.

tests.title: Editor cannot send messages from another user's template (API)
tests.goal: Only the owner can trigger a WhatsApp send for a template.
preconditions: Admin account (TWW_QA_ADMIN_* in .env)
The admin creates a QA editor (and, for viewer cases, a QA viewer) in 用戶管理 > 添加用户 and deletes them afterwards
An admin template whose contacts are all already sent (so nothing can go out)

steps.text: Log in as the QA editor
Call the send endpoint (POST /api/send) with the admin template's ID

expected.text: Refused with 403/404 before any contact check
No message is queued

notes: Editor POST /api/send on another user template -> 404; nothing sent.

tests.title: Editor cannot change contacts of another user's template
tests.goal: Contacts can only be reset or deleted by the template owner.
preconditions: Admin account (TWW_QA_ADMIN_* in .env)
The admin creates a QA editor (and, for viewer cases, a QA viewer) in 用戶管理 > 添加用户 and deletes them afterwards

steps.text: As admin create a draft template qa_owner_<unique> and upload the contacts file
Log in as the QA editor, click 從 Twilio 同步 and open the qa_owner_<unique> card
Add /contacts to the URL and open it
Click 全部重置 and confirm
Click the trash icon of QA Tester and confirm
Log in as admin, open the template's 聯繫人 (then delete the template as cleanup)

expected.text: The editor cannot reach the contacts page, or 全部重置 and delete are refused with a no-permission message
As admin, QA Tester is still there with its original status

notes: Editor reset-all, PATCH and DELETE contact on another user template -> 404; contact intact.

tests.title: Viewer cannot create templates or upload contacts
tests.goal: The 查看者 role is read-only.
preconditions: Admin account (TWW_QA_ADMIN_* in .env)
The admin creates a QA editor (and, for viewer cases, a QA viewer) in 用戶管理 > 添加用户 and deletes them afterwards

steps.text: Log in as the QA viewer
On 消息模版 click 從 Twilio 同步
Click 新建模板, untick Meta, enter qa_viewer_<unique>, body "QA viewer draft", button OK, click 創建模板
If created, open it and upload the contacts file
Delete anything created (cleanup)

expected.text: 新建模板 and 從 Twilio 同步 are not offered to a viewer (or refused with a no-permission message)
No template is created and no contacts are uploaded
The viewer's list shows no other users' templates

notes: Viewer create template, upload, send, reset, delete -> 403 無權限; nothing created in Twilio.

tests.title: Sync shows each user only the templates they may see
tests.goal: 從 Twilio 同步 does not reveal other users' templates.
preconditions: A QA editor created by the admin (delete afterwards)

steps.text: Log in as the QA editor (owns no templates)
Click 從 Twilio 同步

expected.text: Only the editor's templates (none) are listed

notes: Editor and viewer sync return only their own templates (empty); admin templates not visible.

tests.title: Users cannot delete or edit other users' templates
tests.goal: Only the owner (or admin) can delete or edit a template, in the app and in Twilio.
preconditions: A QA editor created by the admin (delete afterwards)
A disposable QA draft owned by the admin

steps.text: As the QA editor call DELETE /api/templates/<admin draft id>
Call PATCH with a new questionTitle
Check the draft in Twilio (Content API or console)

expected.text: Both return 403/404
The Twilio content still exists and the app record is unchanged

notes: Editor DELETE -> 404, viewer DELETE -> 403; Twilio content still exists (GET 200).

tests.title: Editor cannot open the user management page
tests.goal: Admin-only pages are hidden and blocked for editors.
preconditions: A QA editor created by the admin (delete afterwards)

steps.text: Log in as the QA editor
Look at the nav
Open /users directly

expected.text: 用戶管理 is not in the nav
/users shows a no-permission message or redirects; no 添加用户 button

notes: Editor /users -> 307 to /dashboard; /api/users 403.

tests.title: User name of only spaces is rejected
tests.goal: A user must have a visible name.

steps.text: Log in as the admin and open 添加用户
Enter name **"   "** (spaces only), email **qa-<unique>@example.test**, password **Qa123456!**
Click 創建用户
If the user was created, delete it (cleanup)

expected.text: The form shows a required-name error and no user is created
No user card with an empty heading appears in 用户列表

notes: Spaces-only name -> 400 姓名不能為空.

tests.title: Template name accepts only English letters, digits and underscore
tests.goal: Invalid WhatsApp template names are caught before reaching Twilio/Meta.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)

steps.text: Log in as admin and open 新建模板
Untick Meta submission
Enter name **My Template 測試!**, body **hello**, one button **OK**
Click 創建模板

expected.text: A validation message explains the allowed characters (as in the field hint "英文、數字、底線")
No template is created in the app or in Twilio

notes: "My Template 測試!" and "qa-name" -> 400 模板名稱只能包含英文字母、數字和底線.

tests.title: Create form checks WhatsApp template limits before submitting
tests.goal: Invalid templates are caught with a clear Chinese message instead of a Twilio error or a Meta rejection.
preconditions: An admin account (TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS)

steps.text: Open 新建模板 (Meta unticked) and try each: a button title of 25 characters; a body of 1100 characters; the name of an existing template; a body with "{{}}"; two buttons both titled Yes; two buttons with the same ID; a button with an empty ID; a body starting or ending with a variable; a variable without example value while Meta is ticked

expected.text: Each is rejected in the form with a Traditional Chinese message naming the rule (button ≤ 20 chars, body ≤ 1024 chars, unique name, no empty variable, unique button titles/IDs, no variable at start/end, example required)
Nothing is created in Twilio

notes: All listed rules rejected with Traditional Chinese messages (button >20, body >1024, duplicate name, variable at start/end, {{}}, empty/duplicate button IDs, duplicate titles, Meta without example, no buttons). Not covered by the app: names differing only in case, name >450 and spaces-only body (Twilio English errors).

tests.title: Append mode skips numbers already in the list
tests.goal: 追加 never creates two contacts with the same (normalized) phone number.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)

steps.text: Log in as admin, open a draft template with no contacts
Upload the valid HK file with 追加
Upload the phone-formats file with 追加 (contains the same number 4 times in different formats)
Upload the valid HK file again with 追加
Open 聯繫人, then delete all contacts (cleanup)

expected.text: Only one contact with 85265248661 exists
The upload summary counts the duplicates as skipped ("跳過 N 個已存在號碼")

notes: Same number in 4 formats + in-file duplicates: added once; skippedRows lists Excel 文件內重複號碼 / 號碼已存在於此模板.

tests.title: Upload summary reports rows that were not imported
tests.goal: Rows with an invalid or empty phone are reported, not silently dropped.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)

steps.text: Log in as admin, open a draft template with no contacts
Upload the phone-formats file (8 rows: one with letters, one with an empty phone)
Delete the contacts (cleanup)

expected.text: The summary says how many rows were rejected and why (invalid phone / empty phone)
total equals the number of data rows in the file

notes: UI shows 以下 8 筆未導入 with each row and reason (格式不正確, 缺少電話號碼, duplicates).

tests.title: Reset a sent contact to pending
tests.goal: 重置 lets a sent contact be sent again.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)

steps.text: Log in as admin, open 聯繫人 of a template with a 已發送 contact
Click 重置 on that contact

expected.text: The status changes to 待發送 and the 重置 button disappears
The old 發送時間 is cleared (or labelled as the previous send)

notes: After 全部重置 the contact shows 待發送 without 發送時間.

tests.title: Sending is blocked while a template variable has no mapping
tests.goal: Nobody receives a message with a wrong or placeholder value.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)

steps.text: Log in as admin, open an approved template with {{first_name}} and no saved mapping
Upload the valid HK file
Click 發送到 WhatsApp

expected.text: The send is refused with a message naming the unmapped variable ({{first_name}})
Nothing is sent; Twilio shows no new outbound message

notes: Empty mapping: send -> 400 部分聯繫人缺少變數映射，無法發送：QA Tester（缺少：{{first_name}}）; nothing sent.

tests.title: Webhook rejects requests without a valid Twilio signature
tests.goal: Only Twilio can record replies.
preconditions: App running with the ngrok tunnel up

steps.text: POST a form-encoded message to the public /api/webhook/whatsapp URL without an X-Twilio-Signature header, From a phone that matches no contact (e.g. whatsapp:+85200000000)
POST the same with a wrong signature

expected.text: Both return 403 and nothing is logged or recorded
A real reply from WhatsApp (valid signature) is still accepted

notes: Unsigned (via ngrok) and bad-signature requests -> 403 Invalid signature, not saved; real Twilio-signed reply -> 200 and saved.

tests.title: Reset warns before deleting recorded replies
tests.goal: Staff cannot wipe member answers by accident.
preconditions: An admin account (TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS)
A contact with a recorded reply

steps.text: Open 聯繫人 of a template with a replied contact
Click 重置 on that contact
Click 全部重置 and read the confirmation

expected.text: Both actions warn that the reply will be deleted (or keep the reply)
Cancel keeps contacts and replies unchanged

notes: 全部重置 confirm: 確定要將所有聯繫人重置為待發送狀態嗎？這會刪除所有已記錄的回覆，此操作無法復原。 Single 重置 has its own confirm (code).

tests.title: Variable mapping must point to an existing Excel column
tests.goal: A mapping that would send blank or sample values cannot be saved.
preconditions: An admin account (TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS)

steps.text: Open attendance_confirmation with contacts uploaded
In 變數映射配置 save an empty value, then "   ", then "不存在的欄", then "姓名 先生"
Restore 姓名 and save

expected.text: Empty / unknown column is rejected with a message
Free text is either sent literally (as the placeholder "或手動輸入" suggests) or rejected, never silently dropped

notes: Spaces-only mapping -> 400; "姓名 先生" sent as "Hi QA Tester 先生, do you confirm your attendance?" (Twilio delivered). Unknown words are sent as typed text by design.

tests.title: Report shows the text of free-text replies
tests.goal: Staff can read what members typed.
preconditions: An admin account (TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS)
A contact with a free-text reply (TWW-041)

steps.text: Download the report of the template

expected.text: 回覆內容 shows the typed text (e.g. "maybe later"), optionally with the 其它 category
數據統計 counts it under 其他

notes: Free-text reply "maybe later": 回覆內容 in the Excel report shows maybe later (數據統計 counts it under 其他).

tests.title: Role change applies to existing sessions
tests.goal: Demoting a user takes effect without waiting for re-login.
preconditions: A QA editor logged in in a separate session

steps.text: As admin change the QA user to 查看者
Read the QA user's session / try an editor action

expected.text: The session shows VIEWER (or the user must log in again)

notes: EDITOR -> VIEWER: existing session shows role VIEWER at once; create -> 403.

tests.title: Submit a two-variable template for Meta review
tests.goal: A new template with several variables and buttons reaches Meta review and shows 審核中.
preconditions: An admin account (TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS)
data: Name qa_event_reminder_<unique>, body 您好 {{first_name}}，提醒您 {{event_date}} 的活動，請問您會出席嗎？, examples 陳大文 / 11月5日, buttons 會出席 / 不出席 / 未決定, UTILITY

steps.text: Open 新建模板, keep 創建後立即提交 Meta 審核 ticked
Fill the data, click 創建並提交審核
Look at the new card right away, then after 從 Twilio 同步

expected.text: Alert "模板已創建並提交 Meta 審核！審核通過後即可使用。"
The card shows 審核中 immediately (not 草稿), with the question title and 3 button chips
Detail page: 發送到 WhatsApp disabled with "只有審核通過的模板才能發送消息"

notes: Ran with a one-variable template qa_meta_<n> (Meta submitted): card shows 審核中 right after creating; deleted via app (also removed from Twilio).

tests.title: Sync removes templates deleted in Twilio
tests.goal: The app list matches Twilio after 從 Twilio 同步.
preconditions: An admin account (TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS)

steps.text: Create a QA draft
Delete it directly in Twilio (Content Template Builder or API)
Click 從 Twilio 同步

expected.text: The template disappears from the app (or is marked as removed)
The sync count matches the cards shown

tests.title: User management page uses Traditional Chinese consistently
tests.goal: All user-management labels are in Traditional Chinese like the rest of the app.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)

steps.text: Log in as the admin and open 用戶管理
Click 添加用户

expected.text: Labels read 用戶管理, 用戶列表, 添加用戶, 添加新用戶, 創建用戶, 系統管理員, and confirm text 確定要刪除此用戶嗎？
No Simplified characters (户, 统, 员) appear

notes: Labels are Traditional now; the seeded admin is still named 系统管理员 (prisma/seed.ts) on 用戶管理.

tests.title: Contact status follows Twilio delivery and read receipts
tests.goal: The app shows Delivered / Read / Undelivered like Twilio does.
preconditions: An admin account (logged in session or TWW_ADMIN_USER / TWW_ADMIN_PASS in .env)
ngrok tunnel for the Twilio webhook running

steps.text: Make sure the Twilio status webhook reaches the app (ngrok tunnel up)
Send the QA contact (mapped)
Open the message on the phone
Open 聯繫人 and click 刷新

expected.text: After delivery the contact shows a delivered state and time; after opening it shows read
A message to a non-HK number that Twilio marks Undelivered shows as failed, not 已發送

notes: Twilio message MM5ceb… went delivered then read; app stayed 已發送 (no status callback set). 已讀 appeared only after the member replied.

tests.title: Deleting a user ends their sessions
tests.goal: A removed staff member loses access immediately.
preconditions: A QA user logged in in a separate session

steps.text: As admin delete the QA user
With the QA user's existing session, open /templates and call the templates API

expected.text: The old session is rejected (401/redirect to /login)

notes: APIs return 401 and session is empty after deletion (BUG-019 fixed), but opening /templates gives 500 TypeError reading role instead of /login.

tests.title: Logout invalidates the session token
tests.goal: A copied session token stops working after logout.
preconditions: A QA user

steps.text: Log in as the QA user in a separate HTTP session and keep the session cookie
Log out (signout)
Call /api/auth/session and an API with the kept cookie

expected.text: The old cookie is rejected after logout

notes: After signout the copied session cookie still returns the user and /api/templates 200.

tests.title: Viewer has a read-only interface
tests.goal: 查看者 cannot start any write action from the UI.
preconditions: A QA viewer

steps.text: Log in as the QA viewer
Open 消息模版 and a template

expected.text: No 新建模板, 從 Twilio 同步, upload, mapping save, send, reset or delete controls

notes: Viewer sees 新建模板 and 從 Twilio 同步; create form opens and fails only on submit with 無權限.
